about: Kropyvnytskyi: an old merchant city and a private sector

Kropyvnytskyi lies in the very centre of Ukraine, with a 19th-century merchant centre, apartment-block estates and a large private sector along the Inhul. There are fewer new complexes than in bigger regional centres, so most requests are about updating existing homes.

For such homes an accurate estimate matters most: what to replace in the services, whether to level the walls, which structures to keep. We start with it, so the budget does not drift halfway through the renovation.

For apartments in older buildings — replanning within the structure, new bathrooms and kitchens, built-in furniture; for houses — room for a large family, a terrace, a boiler room and a pantry. Packages from planning to full. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate apartments and houses, from [major renovation](/en/major-renovation) to cosmetic. Near Kropyvnytskyi we build aerated-block, brick and timber-frame houses, from the architectural design to turnkey finishing.

Renovation is carried out by our salaried team: from $550 per m² for works and rough materials, with finishing materials, furniture and appliances priced separately per estimate. Scope, schedule and payment plan (50/50, 50/30/20 or in stages, from a 10% advance) are fixed in the contract; team travel is on individual terms. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m² — see [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Design and approvals run online; we travel for measurements and key stages on the schedule set in the contract, and the terms and costs of travel and team accommodation are individual. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks, and an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.
